verdict.rationale: Slack's Block Kit is explicitly documented as the JSON-based framework for building modals, messages, and tabs with the same building blocks, backed by chat.postMessage's structured 'blocks' parameter, plus SDKs (Bolt for Java/Python/JS, Node Slack SDK) and CLI tooling to build these apps. This directly matches the story of building rich interactive UI (modals, buttons, structured layouts) inside Slack chat. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the Block Kit UI-building experience beyond first-party docs.
